test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: When the speed of a car is increased by 30%, it takes 24 minutes less to cover the same distance. What is the time taken by it to cover the same distance at its usual speed?
solution:
**Given:**

When usual Speed (S) increased = 30%

Time Taken = Usual Time(T) - 24 minutes

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

The distance traveled by car in each scenario is the same

Let the usual speed of the car be 'a'

⇒ Increased speed × TIme Taken = Usual speed × Time Taken

&am
